title: Weekend Adventure Trips from Bengaluru
seoTitle: Weekend Adventure Trips from Bengaluru | Kudozz Club
metaDescription: Weekend adventure trips from Bengaluru: rock climbing at Ramanagara, Savandurga and Skandagiri treks, Coorg rafting, Dandeli, Chikmagalur peaks and Netrani diving.
description: The best weekend adventure trips from Bengaluru: rock climbing at Ramanagara, hill climbs at Savandurga, Skandagiri and Kunti Betta, cycling at Nandi Hills, rafting at Barapole in Coorg and on the Kali at Dandeli, treks at Chikmagalur and Kudremukh, bouldering at Hampi, and diving at Netrani.
dek: Granite hills an hour from the city, rivers in Coorg and Dandeli, and the Western Ghats beyond: Bengaluru has some of the best adventure weekends in India.

hero.caption: Savandurga

intro: Bengaluru sits on the Deccan plateau, surrounded by granite hills that make excellent short climbs and treks. A few hours further west, the Western Ghats bring rivers for rafting, coffee country for trekking and cycling, and the Arabian Sea coast for diving and surfing.
Many treks in Karnataka's forests now need online booking and have fixed timings, set by the state forest department, so check before you go. This guide groups trips by distance.
quickAnswer: The best weekend adventure trips from Bengaluru are rock climbing at Ramanagara, hill climbs at Savandurga, Skandagiri and Kunti Betta, cycling at Nandi Hills, rafting at Barapole in Coorg (monsoon) and on the Kali at Dandeli (October to May), treks around Chikmagalur and Kudremukh, bouldering at Hampi and diving at Netrani Island. Book forest treks through the Karnataka forest department where required.
takeaways: Ramanagara, Savandurga and Skandagiri are within about 50 to 70 km of the city.
Barapole rafting in Coorg is a monsoon activity; Dandeli rafts outside the monsoon.
Mullayanagiri near Chikmagalur is Karnataka's highest peak, at about 1,930 metres.
Many Karnataka forest treks need online booking and have daily limits.
Hampi bouldering and Netrani diving suit long weekends by overnight train or bus.

sections.heading: Close to the city (1 to 2 hours)

items.name: Ramanagara rock climbing
body: Granite crags with top-rope, trad and bouldering, and introductory sessions run by Bengaluru climbing groups.

items.name: Savandurga
body: One of the largest monolith hills in Asia, climbed on a steep rock path. Start early to avoid the heat.

items.name: Skandagiri
body: A short night or pre-dawn climb for sunrise above the clouds; the forest department controls timings and bookings.

items.name: Nandi Hills cycling
body: The climb up Nandi Hills is Bengaluru's favourite cycling challenge on weekend mornings.

items.name: Kunti Betta
body: A rocky twin hill near Pandavapura, popular for night treks and camping.

items.name: Coorg: rafting and treks
body: Barapole rafting runs in the monsoon, about June to October, and Tadiandamol, the highest peak in Kodagu, is a day trek.

facts.Season: Rafting in the monsoon; treks October to February

items.name: Chikmagalur and Kudremukh
body: Mullayanagiri, at about 1,930 metres, is Karnataka's highest peak; Kudremukh's grassland ridges are a national park trek with permits.

items.name: Dandeli rafting and kayaking
body: Rafting and kayaking on the Kali river, with forest stays nearby.

items.name: Wayanad
body: Treks to Chembra Peak (when open) and forest walks, just across the border in Kerala.

items.name: Hampi bouldering
body: Overnight train or bus to Hosapete, then two days on the boulders.

items.name: Netrani diving and Mulki surfing
body: Dive trips to Netrani Island from Murudeshwar, or surf lessons at Mulki near Mangaluru.

items.name: Yelagiri, Tamil Nadu
body: A small hill station with trekking and adventure activities, about three to four hours from Bengaluru.

sections.heading: Three sample weekends

items.name: Rocks near the city
body: Saturday: sunrise climb at Savandurga, then an afternoon climbing session at Ramanagara with a local group. Sunday: early cycle up Nandi Hills, back for breakfast.

items.name: Monsoon in Coorg
body: Friday night: drive or bus to Coorg. Saturday: Barapole rafting and a plantation stay. Sunday: Abbey Falls or a short walk, drive back.

items.name: Coffee-country peaks
body: Friday night: drive to Chikmagalur. Saturday: sunrise at Mullayanagiri and a walk along the ridge. Sunday: a waterfall or estate walk, return.

after: Bengaluru's traffic makes early starts essential. For Hampi, Dandeli, Murudeshwar and Mulki, overnight trains and buses save a day of driving.

sections.heading: Getting out of the city
list: Leave before 6 am on weekends to clear the city; traffic on the Mysuru and Tumakuru roads builds quickly.
Overnight KSRTC and private buses serve Coorg, Chikmagalur, Hampi and the coast.
Trains run to Hosapete for Hampi, to Mysuru for Coorg, and along the Konkan coast from Mangaluru.

sections.heading: Weekend tips
list: Check the Karnataka forest department's booking system for treks such as Skandagiri, Kudremukh and Kumara Parvatha before setting out.
Leave before dawn for the close hills to beat heat and traffic.
In the monsoon, many forest treks close, but Coorg rafting is at its best.
Carry ID; forest checkposts record trekkers.

safety: Start rock climbs early; granite heats up by late morning.
Climb and trek with groups or guides on less-used routes.
Follow forest department timings and do not enter closed areas.
Raft only with licensed operators, and skip rivers in flood.
Carry at least two litres of water on Deccan hill climbs.

faqs.q: What are the best adventure activities near Bengaluru?
faqs.a: Rock climbing at Ramanagara, hill climbs at Savandurga and Skandagiri, cycling at Nandi Hills, rafting in Coorg and Dandeli, and treks in Chikmagalur.

faqs.q: Do I need to book treks near Bengaluru?
faqs.a: Many Karnataka forest treks now need online booking through the forest department, with daily limits and fixed timings.

faqs.q: When is rafting available in Coorg?
faqs.a: In the monsoon, from about June to October, on the Barapole river.

faqs.q: Which is the highest peak in Karnataka?
faqs.a: Mullayanagiri near Chikmagalur, at about 1,930 metres.

faqs.q: Where can I rock climb near Bengaluru?
faqs.a: At Ramanagara, Savandurga and Turahalli, often with local climbing groups.

faqs.q: What is the best season for adventure weekends from Bengaluru?
faqs.a: October to February for hill climbs, treks and climbing; June to October for rafting in Coorg.

faqs.q: How far is Coorg from Bengaluru?
faqs.a: About 250 km, or five to six hours by road.
